name: MANGO-Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 65536). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct: 48 full GQA layers in the thinker's MoE text decoder (kv heads 4, head_dim 128, 32 query heads, gqa_ratio 8), per the base config.json thinker_config.text_config. The talker decoder and the vision/audio encoders are untouched by this fine-tune.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-06. A LoRA SFT (r8/alpha16, all-linear, language backbone only) of Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct for Thai, merged to a standalone 35.26B checkpoint across 15 shards. Vision tower and aligner frozen, so every delta is attributable to text-side adaptation. Trained on ~107.8K samples (59% Thai / 41% English) for 3 epochs, lr 1e-4, 2x8 A100-40GB. Recorded because the card prints baseline and this model as rows of the same ThaiLLM-Leaderboard normalized-average table (0.379 -> 0.467) and the same 15-benchmark VL table. PARAMS DIVERGENCE: the base record carries 30.0B from its slug, while this repo's safetensors index totals 35.26B - the difference is the talker, ViT and audio encoder that the 30B-A3B name omits; the base record should be corrected the same way. Card caveat kept in the benchmark configs: the +3.1-point margin over the text-only SFT sibling is confounded with an 11x training-volume difference. Licence Qwen (other), repo created 2026-04-20.

benchmarks.name: ThaiLLM-Leaderboard 9-benchmark normalized average
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Model | Norm. Avg |': baseline Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct 0.379 vs this model 0.467 (text-only SFT sibling 0.435). Nine Thai NLP benchmarks under the ThaiLLM-Leaderboard protocol (M3Exam, Thai-Exam, FLORES, iApp QA, XLSum, Belebele, Wisesight, XCOPA, XNLI). LoRA r8/alpha16 on the language backbone only, ViT and aligner frozen. Card caveat: this checkpoint trained on ~107.8K samples vs ~9.9K for the text-only sibling, an 11x volume confound.
